reason: I'm only here for a week and Korean places are on every block, so nothing here tells me why I should go out of my way for this one. Kalbi at $38.95 before tax is steep, and $18.95 for cold noodles is fine but not a reason to make the trip.
objection: Korean food is everywhere in Honolulu. Why this one? I see prices and a menu but no proof it's better than the place next to my hotel.
would_change_my_mind: Strong recent reviews or a local friend saying the kudzu naengmyeon is the best in town. Then I'd try one bowl.
